blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public trust in President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. edged up in September, but Vice President Sara Duterte continued to record a higher trust rating despite facing an ongoing impeachment trial, according to a Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey.
